international.title: Condo manager says DC gym shooter confessed in phone call, noting dispute over living conditions
international.summary: Gunman killed one person and injured at least five others in and around condo building not far from the White House More details were emerging on Friday about the previous morning’s shooting in north-west Washington DC, as a manager at the shooter’s residential building shared how he was angry over living conditions there and confessed to the killings. The gunman killed one person and injured at least five others on Thursday in and around the condominium building in the Logan Circle neighborhood of the capital, not far from the White House, where he lived.
